Abida said one hair of the Prophet would be dearer to him than the world, and Abu Talha took the first of his hair when his head was shaved.
People wiped themselves with the Prophet's leftover ablution water, he had Abu Musa and Bilal drink and pour from his tumbler, and companions nearly fought over such water.
The Prophet was given five things no earlier prophet had: victory by awe, the earth for prayer and Tayammum, lawful booty, a mission to all mankind, and intercession.
Allah gives religious understanding to whom He wills good; He is the Giver and the Prophet only the distributor, giving as ordered, and this nation stays victorious.
Asked how to send blessings on him, the Prophet teaches asking Allah to bless Muhammad and his family as He blessed Abraham and Abraham's family.
Zainab bint Abi Salama confirms that the Prophet was of the tribe of Mudar, descended from An-Nadr bin Kinana, and reports his ban on four kinds of wine vessels.
The Prophet's five names include Al-Mahi, Al-Hashir and Al-Aqib, no prophet after him; Quraish curse Mudhammam, not Muhammad; he is the last brick completing the prophets' house.
The Prophet is closest to every believer; a dead believer's property goes to his heirs, but his debts and poor children are to be brought to the Prophet.
Asked how to invoke Allah for him, the Prophet teaches the words asking Allah to bless Muhammad and his family as He blessed Abraham's family.
Verse 48.8 appears in the Torah with more: the Prophet as Allah's slave named Al-Mutawakkil, not harsh or loud, forgiving, through whom a crooked nation is guided.
The Prophet names himself Muhammad, Ahmad, Al-Mahi through whom disbelief is wiped out, Al-Hashir at whose feet people are gathered, and Al-Aqib.
Asked how to send Salat on him, the Prophet taught 'O Allah, send Salat on Muhammad and his family as on Abraham's family', and invoked Salat on those bringing alms.
Aisha said not to believe anyone claiming the Prophet concealed part of the revelation, since Allah ordered him to proclaim all that was sent down.
